description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Seahawks signed FB Jackson Acker.
items.impact: Acker will remain off the fantasy radar.
items.title: Jackson Acker signs with Seahawks

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Colts coach Shane Steichen said Alec Pierce will not practice this week.
items.impact: Pierce remains without a clear timetable to return. He is week-to-week.
items.title: Alec Pierce (heel) will not practice this week

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Colts head coach Shane Steichen confirmed that Daniel Jones will start in Week 7 against the Vikings.
items.impact: Jones struggles continued in Sunday's loss against the Titans. He'll be a low-end QB2 play in Week 7 against the Vikings defense.
items.title: Daniel Jones will start in Week 7

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Kyle Dugger was back in uniform for practice on Monday.
items.impact: Dugger will need to be monitored in practice throughout the week.
items.title: Kyle Dugger back in uniform at practice Monday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Brian Branch remains on track to return in Week 7 against the Packers.
items.impact: Branch has returned to practice and he is expected to be activated later this week. The same goes for center Cade Mays. "Barring anything negatively happening between now and the game, we plan on playing both of those guys," Lions head coach Dan Campbell said.
items.title: Brian Branch (Achilles) on track to return in Week 7

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Cade Mays remains on track to return in Week 7 against the Packers.
items.impact: Mays has returned to practice and he is expected to be activated later this week. The same goes for safety Brian Branch. "Barring anything negatively happening between now and the game, we plan on playing both of those guys," Lions head coach Dan Campbell said.
items.title: Cade Mays (wrist) on track to return in Week 7

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Seahawks signed TE Josiah Deguara to their practice squad.
items.impact: Deguara will add depth in the Seahawks tight end room with Elijah Arroyo expected to miss time.
items.title: Josiah Deguara signs with Seahawks

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Falcons released QB Cooper Rush.
items.impact: Rush struggled to begin the season as the Falcons starter. Atlanta signed Andy Dalton as the corresponding move.
items.title: Cooper Rush released by Falcons

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Falcons signed QB Andy Dalton.
items.impact: Dalton was recently released by the Eagles. He could compete with Tua Tagovailoa to backup Michael Penix Jr.
items.title: Andy Dalton signs with Falcons

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Elijah Arroyo is expected to be placed on injured reserve.
items.impact: Arroyo is expected to miss an extended period of time. He'll miss at least four weeks if/when he is placed on injured reserve.
items.title: Elijah Arroyo (shoulder) to likely be placed on IR

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Monroe Freeling could return in Week 7 against the Buccaneers.
items.impact: "This is a first-round pick for us but we're gonna do what's best for the Panthers," Panthers coach Dave Canales said. Freeling will need to be monitored in practice throughout the week.
items.title: Monroe Freeling (knee) could return in Week 7

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.desc: Jalon Daniels is starting off practice on Wednesday as the presumed starter, at least for initial game planning, for Week 7. Baker Mayfield is set to return to practice, and his performance will likely determine which of the two will end up being named the starter against Carolina.
items.impact: If Mayfield shows enough spark throughout the weeks and few ill effects from his injury, Mayfield will likely start unless the Bucs show an abundance of caution and start Daniels anyway. If Baker can't go, Daniels has shown decent enough ability when rushing to at least give him a floor, but lacks much of a ceiling due to little passing production in each of his three starts.
items.title: Jalon Daniels starter status up in the air Mayfield returning

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.desc: Baker Mayfield (thumb) is set to practice on Wednesday to test his health for Week 7's contest against Carolina.
items.impact: While Mayfield is expected to start practicing, the team is still planning as if Jalon Daniels will start in Week 7, which isn't surprising given the situation. If Mayfield is healthy enough to start, then he will likely lead the team against the Panthers and be a low-end QB2 for fantasy.
items.title: Baker Mayfield (thumb) set to practice on Wednesday

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.desc: Sauce Gardner (calf) is expected to miss time with a calf strain and is labeled week-to-week. However, he's not expected to miss an extended period.
items.impact: Gardner was unable to finish the Colts game against the Titans due to the injury. It's tough blow to an already struggling secondary, but it's not as if Gardner is wasn't part of the problem.
items.title: Sauce Gardner (calf) expected to miss time with calf strain

items.author: Leo Sells
items.desc: The Raiders' D/ST logged two sacks and allowed 33 points in Sunday's loss to the Buffalo Bills.
items.impact: Las Vegas' defense was outmatched on Sunday. They allowed Buffalo's offense to score 33 points over the course of the afternoon, and they weren't able to log any big plays to help turn the tide of the game. This unit shouldn't be started moving forward, even in favorable matchups.
items.title: Raiders D/ST struggles in loss Sunday

items.author: Leo Sells
items.desc: Matt Gay went 3-for-3 on his field-goal attempts and 3-for-3 on his extra-point attempts in Sunday's 33-30 loss to the Buffalo Bills.
items.impact: Gay did his job on Sunday, knocking down all six of his attempted kicks in Las Vegas' narrow loss to the Buffalo Bills. Fantasy managers should be happy with his performance and should continue to view him as a decent fantasy option at the position moving forward.
items.title: Matt Gay scores 12 points in loss Sunday

items.author: Leo Sells
items.desc: Dylan Laube rushed the ball one time for zero yards and caught one pass for -1 yards in Sunday's 33-30 loss to the Buffalo Bills.
items.impact: Laube was able to play on Sunday but didn't do much against the Bills. He saw just two touches and finished with negative yards in this matchup. He is clearly eclipsed by Mike Washington Jr. on the depth chart at this point, so he will be irrelevant from a fantasy perspective moving forward.
items.title: Dylan Laube uninvolved in loss Sunday

items.author: Leo Sells
items.desc: Jalen Nailor caught 1-of-4 targets for nine yards in Sunday's 33-30 loss to the Buffalo Bills.
items.impact: Nailor wasn't able to do much on Sunday. He caught just one pass over the course of the game and was only able to turn that into nine yards, which left him with a terrible fantasy total. Fantasy managers shouldn't have high expectations for him moving forward.
items.title: Jalen Nailor quiet in loss Sunday

items.author: Leo Sells
items.desc: Michael Mayer hauled in 7-of-9 targets for 95 yards in Sunday's 33-30 loss to the Buffalo Bills.
items.impact: Mayer had a great performance on Sunday. He set a new career high in receiving yards against the Bills, racking up 95 on his seven catches, which left him with a great fantasy total. He may have some good games here or there moving forward, but he's unlikely to be a reliable week-to-week asset with TE Brock Bowers still easily ahead of him in the pecking order at this point.
items.title: Michael Mayer hauls in seven passes Sunday

items.author: Leo Sells
items.desc: Mike Washington Jr. rushed the ball nine times for 43 yards and caught one pass for seven yards in Sunday's 33-30 loss to the Buffalo Bills.
items.impact: Washington was surprisingly involved on Sunday. He saw just one less carry than Ashton Jeanty over the course of the afternoon, and he was much more efficient with his work, leading the team in rushing yards at an efficient clip of 4.8 yards per carry as opposed to Jeanty's 2.2 yards per carry. Washington may be earning more touches for himself moving forward, which would be bad news for the fantasy value of Jeanty.
items.title: Mike Washington Jr. leads team in rushing Sunday
